tests: FIRST CYCLE A: Accept a canonical S1 published TrainingAttempt; preserve its initial analysis, context, and boundary without mutation.
FIRST CYCLE A: Accept a correct analysis with primary_error=None, abstain=false, and empty contributors; do not auto-abstain when no error exists.
FIRST CYCLE A: Accept exactly one eligible primary_error, zero contributors, one contributor, and two contributors in separate cases.
FIRST CYCLE A: Cover an abstain path with no formal errors, preserve useful what_was_correct, and verify skill_signal for primary-error, first-contributor, and Stage fallback branches.
FIRST CYCLE B: Reject S2 and S3 errors on an S1 attempt; reject S3 errors on an S2 attempt.
FIRST CYCLE B: Permit an eligible S1 error on an S2 attempt when a mapped historical learned CORE concept supports it.
FIRST CYCLE B: Reject a formal error whose mapped concept is unlearned; require canonical allowed CORE membership as well as learned membership.
FIRST CYCLE B: Later mutation of the original learned-concept collection cannot expand Evaluation authority; later Learning Map knowledge is not consulted.
FIRST CYCLE C: Reject more than two contributors, duplicate contributors, and primary_error duplicated in contributors.
FIRST CYCLE C: Reject abstain with primary_error, abstain with contributors, and LOW confidence with abstain=false; allow authorized MEDIUM/HIGH abstention.
FIRST CYCLE C: Reject unknown Error IDs; prove no alternate error-list path exists and canonical Error ID tokens in primary_issue/hint cannot substitute for formal errors.
FIRST CYCLE D: Direct public Evaluation record construction cannot bypass validation or Training/historical-boundary checks; output exposes exactly nine frozen persistent shared fields.

At the expected main baseline require spec/evaluation/.gitkeep present with blob e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391, EVALUATION_SPEC.md absent, src/price_action_learning/evaluation/ absent, and tests/evaluation/ absent. Any difference is STALE; do not silently adapt the frozen mutation scope.

Create exactly spec/evaluation/EVALUATION_SPEC.md, src/price_action_learning/evaluation/__init__.py, src/price_action_learning/evaluation/core.py, and tests/evaluation/test_evaluation.py. Delete exactly spec/evaluation/.gitkeep after the real spec exists. The five concrete scope_paths are the entire business mutation scope; no other business path is authorized.

Evaluation owns validated diagnostic feedback for exactly one already-submitted TrainingAttempt. Preserve the user-first invariant: the user supplies initial analysis before evaluator diagnosis. Never generate, overwrite, revise, or mutate attempt.user_analysis; never mutate the attempt, attempt.context, or attempt.context.knowledge_boundary.

Use one immutable Evaluation record with exactly nine persistent fields, in the shared contract: attempt_id, what_was_correct, primary_issue, primary_error, contributors, hint, skill_signal, evaluation_confidence, abstain. Do not modify docs/CONTRACTS.md, add any persistent field (including a hidden authority field), or introduce a second/parallel Evaluation record.

Expose a canonical public factory such as create_evaluation(...). The Evaluation record must not offer unrestricted public direct construction that bypasses TrainingAttempt and historical-boundary validation. A frozen dataclass with direct initialization disabled is acceptable if it preserves exactly the nine shared fields. Review every public constructor and factory in the first cycle.

Require a real published TrainingAttempt, rejecting arbitrary duck-typed attempt, context, or boundary substitutes. Defensively validate/canonicalize it using the already-published Training contract before evaluating. Reject forged or caller-tampered TrainingAttempt values that no longer satisfy canonical constructor invariants; reject duck-typed TrainingContext. Copy/reconstruct canonical values without altering any input object or nested boundary.

Interpret supplied evaluator diagnostic content only in the context of attempt.context.observation_task, primary_objective, target_concept_id, attempt.stage, and the frozen knowledge_boundary. Add no target/objective override parameter and no unrestricted whole-chart scope. No semantic NLP engine or technical-analysis classifier is required.

Evaluate the submitted analysis process, never subsequent market outcomes. The public API must accept no later price movement, realized P/L, trade result, market prediction result, or future candles. Use only the submitted attempt context plus evaluator diagnostic content; produce no prediction or trading signal.

Store what_was_correct as an immutable tuple[str, ...], possibly empty. Each supplied item must be a canonical non-empty base str after defensive copying/normalization. Preserve useful correct observations; positive assessment must also fit the historical CORE, allowed, learned boundary. Do not add generalized NLP validation.

Store primary_issue and hint as str | None. They contain diagnostic/educational prose only. Reject empty or whitespace-only supplied text. Protect the canonical Error-ID protocol by rejecting approved Error ID tokens used inside primary_issue or hint as substitute formal-error containers. Do not build generalized NLP detection; the hint cannot become a second primary error, future-stage judgment, signal, or forecast.

Store primary_error as str | None: at most one canonical approved Error ID. Store contributors as an immutable tuple[str, ...] of canonical approved Error IDs with length 0..2, unique, and excluding primary_error. Do not create any alternate error-list field or parameter path that bypasses this cardinality.

Canonical S1 Error IDs are exactly OBS-001, OBS-002, OBS-004, STR-001, STR-002, STR-006, STR-007. Canonical S2 Error IDs are exactly STR-003, STR-004, STR-005, REA-002, REA-003, REA-005. Canonical S3 Error IDs are exactly LOC-001, LOC-002, LOC-003, LOC-004, LOC-005, LOC-006. Use no new Error IDs.

Canonical skills are exactly SKL-S1-MARKET-STATE, SKL-S2-STRUCTURE-MOVEMENT, SKL-S3-MARKET-LOCATION. Runtime compatibility data may contain only the minimum immutable Error->Stage, Error->related Skill, Error->related Concept IDs, and Stage->primary Skill mappings derived from the immutable Learning Map. Duplicate no concept definitions, teaching content, or broader Learning Map logic; caller-supplied mapping expansion is forbidden.

For every requested primary_error and contributor: require a canonical approved ID; require its canonical Error Stage not later than the attempt Stage; require at least one canonically mapped Concept ID both in the submission-time learned_concept_ids and in the attempt Stage canonical allowed CORE boundary. Reject the formal error when no mapped learned supporting concept exists. All currently approved S1-S3 concepts are CORE; authorize no future confidence expansion.

S1 attempts admit only eligible S1 errors; S2 attempts admit eligible S1 or S2 errors; S3 attempts admit eligible S1, S2, or S3 errors. Use the stored historical Training boundary, never current/later learning or later Learning Map knowledge. Later caller mutation must not expand historical Evaluation authority. Do not allow callers to supply or expand Error->Concept mappings.

Store abstain as a strict bool; reject truthy duck-typed or bool-like substitutes. If abstain=true require primary_error=None and contributors=(). If evaluation_confidence=LOW require abstain=true. MEDIUM/HIGH may also abstain for authorized reasons such as unavailable permitted knowledge. A correct analysis may use abstain=false, primary_error=None, contributors=(); absence of error alone is not abstention.

Store evaluation_confidence using exactly canonical HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW strings. It describes evaluator certainty for this diagnostic assessment, separately from Learning Map Knowledge Confidence; it is not a score, rank, reward, or probability of future price movement. LOW enforces abstention.

Derive skill_signal internally and expose no caller override. With primary_error, use that Error ID canonical related Skill; otherwise with contributors, use the first contributor canonical related Skill; otherwise use the attempt Stage canonical primary Skill. Do not mutate LearningState.

For all stored text, reject supplied empty/whitespace-only values, normalize str subclasses into independent base str values before canonical scalar comparisons, and reject malformed non-string collection members. Defensively copy caller-owned containers, store collections as immutable tuples, and retain no mutable caller alias. Reject equality-spoofing and duck-typed substitutes where canonical scalar types are required. Output remains historically immutable after post-call caller mutation.

EVALUATION_SPEC.md must define ownership/non-goals, user-first invariant, process-not-outcome rule, historical knowledge boundary, exact nine-field contract and immutable representations, formal Error eligibility algorithm, primary/contributor cardinality, abstain/confidence semantics, skill_signal derivation, hostile-constructor boundary, no future-market-outcome dependency, and no LearningState/Review mutation.

Learning Map reserves detailed error detection criteria for Evaluation, but this MVP defines only validation and the contract boundary for evaluator-supplied diagnostic content. Invent no detailed natural-language detection criteria or full technical-analysis classifier.

core.py contains only the minimum Evaluation domain implementation. __init__.py exports only the intended public Evaluation API. Standard library only, with no network dependency, external LLM SDK, or persistence.
